Arsonists are a dangerous crew mask that specializes in lighting fires across the station. They do not have any unique gear or equipment: just the innate will to see things burn to a crisp.
Although the Arsonist progresses their objective by lighting fires, extinguishing fires will undo the progress, even if it's for a fire they didn't create. This means that they are wholly incapable of containing any fires they start, as extinguishing any amount of spread would undo the progress made.
[italic][color=gray]Note the variety of fire-starting equipment on-station[/color][/italic]
